narrative.overview: This specification records the landing page at / only. Its visual direction follows the user-selected reference: a bright countryside illustration, generous breathing room, and a concise path from importing material to keeping useful knowledge. The illustration supports the product story while the overlaid learning-interface preview makes the existing workflow tangible. The page describes LearnFlux as a personal AI learning workspace used locally. It does not imply public launch or make claims about pricing, customers, source licensing, or hosted availability. Other pages await the user review.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces, readable dark-green text, and restrained leaf-green actions.
An original countryside illustration with a compact, clearly labeled interface preview.
Editorial Chinese headlines paired with familiar system body text.
Clear actions that lead into the existing local learning workflow.
dos: Keep the headline, landscape, and preview as the landing page main visual hierarchy.
Use specific copy to distinguish video transcripts from document and text reading.
Keep local use and the current product state clear.
donts: Do not imply that the illustrative preview is an interactive player.
Do not add public launch, pricing, customer, or licensing claims without a confirmed decision.
Do not treat this landing-page design as approval to redesign the workbench or other pages.
